title: Premise gate
description: Normative contract for the coder-skill premise gate (PRs #946/#947). Two consumers: (1) this document IS a JSON Schema (draft-07) validating one premise telemetry record from the coder jsonl ($CODER_LOG_DIR/$(hostname -s).jsonl); (2) the x-gate-rules extension holds the normative judge constants -- the prose in SKILL.md references this file instead of restating field names or thresholds. Changing anything in x-gate-rules requires re-running scripts/premise-gate-battery.sh (9-state smoke battery, audit #946 section 5.6) before merge.

verdict.description: Scout's premise verdict after the judge confirm-ride (post-softening).

proposed_verdict.description: Judge choice-arm answer: proceed | proceed_with_deviation. Absent on fallback.

consistent.description: Judge premise_consistent noul (0..1), predicate-positive wording per x-gate-rules.question. Absent on fallback.

fallback.description: true when the judge was unavailable/failed and scout's verdict stood.

gate_decision.description: What the orchestrator actually did: stop (before PLAN), soften (falsified/blocked -> diverges), proceed. Recorded so audit #946 section 7 checkpoints can compute firing rate and stop precision without re-deriving from threshold prose.

x-gate-rules.question: Is the issue's premise consistent with this evidence?
x-gate-rules.polarity: predicate-positive -- the dangerous 'yes' must mean proceed, never stop (audit #946 section 5.6; arXiv 2306.08189, 2601.13537, 2509.08480)
x-gate-rules.stop_rule: scout falsified/blocked stands as a stop only if premise_consistent noul <= stop_threshold; above it the stop softens to diverges
x-gate-rules.never_create_stop: scout sound proceeds as sound regardless of noul; the judge may confirm or soften a stop but never create one
x-gate-rules.disagreement_rule: noul <= disagreement_threshold on a scout-sound verdict is surfaced as scout-judge disagreement at presentation (low consistency = judge dissents with scout; the judge still never creates a stop)
x-gate-rules.fallback: never fatal: judge unavailable/API failure/{fallback: true} envelope -> scout's verdict stands, log fallback: true
x-gate-rules.telemetry: {stage: 'premise', verdict, proposed_verdict, consistent, fallback, gate_decision} appended to the same jsonl as SKILL.md Constraint #10; never block on logging failures; on fallback omit proposed_verdict/consistent or set them to null

citation_gate.question: Is each path:line citation verifiable at that exact anchor in the worktree?
citation_gate.polarity: predicate-positive -- a verified citation confirms the claim; noul on this gate never stops the run (audit #946 section 5.6; arXiv 2306.08189, 2601.13537, 2509.08480)
citation_gate.never_create_fail: the judge may confirm or soften a mechanical citation FAIL but never create one; the shell check is the only FAIL producer
citation_gate.disagreement_rule: a judge verdict that disagrees with the mechanical verdict on an anchor is surfaced as judge-mechanical disagreement at presentation
citation_gate.fallback: never fatal: judge unavailable/API failure/{fallback: true} envelope -> mechanical check's verdict stands, log fallback: true
citation_gate.claim_support: one batched noul question per report: is each citation's content supportive of the claim it anchors?; provider/model/env-var claims (SDK string literals, URLs/endpoints, process.env.* keys) are first-class; a lookup grounds only via issue text, an authoritative vendor source, or an accepted artifact (user/maintainer decision, recorded in a pipeline handoff); junk or third-party-only results do not ground; low noul on any anchor = judge-mechanical disagreement surfaced at presentation; batches all anchors into a single call
citation_gate.telemetry: {stage: 'citation', verdict, fallback, disagreements} appended to the same jsonl as SKILL.md Constraint #10; never block on logging failures

plan_completeness.question: Is every externally-observable fact in this plan either verbatim in the issue text or explicitly marked as a grounded decision?
plan_completeness.polarity: predicate-positive -- a confirmed 'complete' means proceed; the dangerous 'yes' must mean proceed, never stop (issue #1107)
plan_completeness.fact_rule: a fact passes iff value is non-empty AND (source == 'grounded' OR (source == 'issue' AND value appears verbatim in the issue text)); any failing or malformed fact proposes 'incomplete', else 'complete'; an absent or empty external_facts array proposes 'complete' (vacuous -- presence is a PLAN-phase prose duty, not a runner-enforced one)
plan_completeness.never_create_stop: the judge may confirm or soften a mechanical 'incomplete' but never creates one; a mechanical 'complete' proceeds regardless of the judge answer
plan_completeness.disagreement_rule: noul <= disagreement_threshold on a mechanical-complete proposal is surfaced as judge-mechanical disagreement at presentation
plan_completeness.soften_rule: mechanical 'incomplete' softens to proceed iff the judge choice arm answers 'complete' (facts traceable); the softened run surfaces judge-mechanical disagreement at presentation
plan_completeness.rework_rule: mechanical 'incomplete' + judge 'incomplete' (or fallback) -> gate_decision rework: rewrite 02-plan.json in place (ground the offending facts first) and re-run the gate; BUILD never spawns while gate_decision is rework
plan_completeness.fallback: never fatal: judge unavailable/API failure/{fallback: true} envelope -> the mechanical proposal stands, log fallback: true; bouncer has no fallback path (the engine-side scan is local and cannot fail open)
plan_completeness.telemetry: {stage: 'plan_completeness', proposal, field_list, judge_answer, noul, fallback, gate_decision} appended to the same jsonl as SKILL.md Constraint #10; never block on logging failures; on fallback omit judge_answer/noul or set them to null; field_list is the plan's external_facts values as kind:value pairs (e.g. ['model:sonnet', 'api_surface:maxTurns']) so logged records name the facts the gate evaluated

trigger_exclusions.rationale: deliberately excluded from the advisory scan: highly polysemous in real plans (data model, approval endpoint, identity provider); a hard stop on them would burn rework attempts on phases that cannot fix anything (issue #1125)

plan_completeness.undeclared_facts_rule: warning-level advisory, never a stop: trigger-pattern hit in the plan's own text (overview, steps[], recommended_approach; case-insensitive, word-boundary) AND external_facts empty/absent -> gate_decision unchanged, telemetry/event gains undeclared_facts_warning: true + trigger_hits, and the PR body MUST carry an 'External facts' section stating the plan's external claims or their absence (verified at the existing PR-body checkpoints: medium-tier Ship step, CHECK on complex tier); no trigger hit, facts present, or warning acknowledged -> behavior unchanged; recall is partially limited by the fixed list (accepted: a miss leaves behavior identical to today)
plan_completeness.declaration_not_verification: the advisory forces declaration only; it proves nothing about a declared fact's truth -- correctness of declared values is enforced solely by CHECK's citation gate with live lookups
